scope: Timed draw in the local Chromium application with real stage and acting clock. An isolated server and local browser capture prevented all upstream provider traffic. A separate reader received the single actor PNG only.

blindReader.input: The actor-only PNG. No cue, list of cues, stage controls or source repository.
blindReader.comparison: Matches the drawn action of drinking. The independent reading did not establish the liquid inside the cup.
blindReader.comparisonMethod: Review of the returned phrase against the original cue. No automatic referee called.

screenshots.afterReadingAnnotation: The test harness added an explicitly labelled independent reading below the original stage. The untouched in-game audience panel remained paused while awaiting a provider.
